final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor supplied no new admissible evidence and mainly reframed the same record more narrowly. That narrowing is useful but not sufficient to move the case to compliant_with_caveats. A caveated compliant finding would require evidence that the policy predicate is already satisfied, such as current release documentation containing the required disclosure or an approved mitigation/risk acceptance. Here, the record still shows a current material weakness in a named launch use case, a policy requiring disclosure or approved mitigation before certification, and no admissible proof that either condition has been met. Aggregate readiness above threshold and no severity-one rehearsal incidents support that the issue is bounded rather than catastrophic, which is why the case remains suspicious rather than noncompliant on this record. But those facts do not cure the missing compliance link for certification.
